bodyEn: On a wet and windy night on the north-west coast of England, a League Two side sensationally knocked the Premier League champions out of the Carabao Cup. But this is not just a fairytale story of giant-slaying: Fleetwood Town and Arsenal have an unlikely history that stretches back long before Tuesday night’s game.
Arsenal played at their iconic Highbury stadium until 2006, and Fleetwood’s ground has the same title, being named after Highbury Avenue, the adjoining street.

Fleetwood also play in red shirts with white sleeves in the style of the classic Arsenal kit. Nobody is exactly sure why, but according to Ray Curtis, a barman in the town’s King’s Arms: “Fleetwood’s first ever kit, the home kit, was given to them by Arsenal.”
And in the 2000s, not long after Patrick Vieira captained Arsenal, Fleetwood boasted a namesake star: a Brazilian striker called Magno Vieira.

At the 5,300-capacity Highbury on Wednesday morning, the floodlights that Fleetwood had hired for the occasion were being packed away. “It’s back to reality, back to being a League Two team, that’s our normal,” said Zsofia Wright, the ticket office and retail manager.

On Tuesday, the excitement and anticipation started early. “We started getting what team had turned up, who’d flown in, and the whispers started, and it’s like, ‘oh, they’ve gone quite strong’,” Wright said.
“So we were all planning to just enjoy the occasion. And then obviously, we went 1-0 up and everyone was kind of looking at each other, like this isn’t supposed to be happening.”
She said it was back to reality when Arsenal equalised except that “the clock kept on going and the score didn’t change”.

Wright said everyone was on the pitch after the dramatic penalty shootout that saw the Premier League champions and Champions League finalists ousted from the competition. The next stop for players, fans and management was the stadium bar.
“Just incredible,” Wright said. “We were here till about half one last night. It was brilliant, amazing.”

“The atmosphere was crazy,” said Chris Newman, 33, who was at the match with his son. He returned to the club shop on Wednesday to pick up two souvenir programmes. “Everything happened so quick,” he said. “I just didn’t expect it at all.”

The shop has done a roaring trade over the past 36 hours, with half-and-half Fleetwood and Arsenal scarves proving especially popular. One buyer with a London accent said: “I’m a Spurs fan, it’s brilliant.”

Wright said the town was abuzz the morning after: “Bars, pubs that are struggling, they were open till God knows what time yesterday. We just hope it can continue throughout the season, just hope that attendances start to pick up, and get consistency back again through the gates.”
The club’s nicknames – the Cod Army, the Fishermen, the Cods and the Trawlermen – all derive from the Lancashire town’s fishing industry.

Sharon Brooks, who was visiting a fishmonger by the harbour, said: “We thought it’d be three, four or five nil, but they did so well to get a draw and then win on penalties, and five brilliant penalties. It’s nice for a town like Fleetwood, and [against the] Premier League winners last season, they just surprised you didn’t they?”
Her 12-year-old son, Ryan, who is an Arsenal fan, said: “Even though I wanted [Arsenal] to win it, I’m pleased for them.”
In the King’s Arms, everyone was eagerly awaiting Wednesday night’s draw, which will decide who Fleetwood plays next.

Donald Maclean, who missed the game because he was on duty at a nursing home, said: “I saw the goals this morning and I was delighted, over the moon, imagine Fleetwood taking down the Gunners! Never been heard of before, so yes, we’re all delighted about it. Brilliant!”
The Cod Army’s victory has delighted fans partly because it was so unexpected – Fleetwood sit 84 places below Arsenal in the football league pyramid.
Michael Houton said he had thought the result impossible “because Arsenal shouldn’t have got beaten should they? Not against Fleetwood.”

Paul Dagger was so pessimistic about his team’s chances that he had staked £200 at half-time on Arsenal to win at odds of 10/7. “Gyökeres [of Arsenal] scored within five minutes of the start,” he said. “I thought, oh here we go, money’s coming in now. You live and learn.”
Fleetwood fans hope it will be the start of something bigger than just a victory for lovers of the game. “The town needs it,” Dagger said. “As you can see, it’s full of charity shops and vape shops.”
Garry Gill, a retired crane operator, said: “I am a Fleetwood fan and I think it’s fantastic for the town. It’s going to bring coin.
“If they play with the determination they did last night, any team that comes to play now is going to be frightened. And normally, that’s not the case, they think it’s an easy win.”
Jim Buckley said: “It’s magic. We’re a Mickey Mouse town of 25,000 people, there’s no train station. I mean at the Emirates, they can fit three towns the size of this town in there.”
He was not far out – Arsenal’s stadium can hold 60,000 fans.
The drinkers in the King’s Arms said the travelling Arsenal fans had had a good day out despite the embarrasing defeat.
Dagger said: “Two pound twenty a pint in here, two pound fifty a pint over the way. They couldn’t believe it, they were going, facking ‘ell, it’s eight quid where we are.”

Back near the harbour, at the Shark Chippy, there was a lunchtime rush. Dishing up cod and chips, Bethany Taylor said she lived near the ground and could tell the final score from the roar of the crowd and the flares. “It was good, brilliant,” she added. “We weren’t expecting it.”
“It’s an incredible result isn’t it?” said her colleague Louisa Smith.
But do they think Fleetwood can lift the Carabao Cup? “It’d be a struggle, but hopefully they will,” Smith said. “We wish them luck.”

items.titleZh: 弗利特伍德镇击败阿森纳后狂欢
items.summaryZh: 英乙球队弗利特伍德镇点球大战淘汰阿森纳，小镇沉浸在喜悦中。
bodyZh: 在一个英格兰西北海岸湿冷且多风的夜晚，一支英乙球队在联赛杯中爆冷将英超冠军淘汰出局。但这并不仅仅是一个以弱胜强的童话故事：弗利特伍德镇与阿森纳之间有着一段可以追溯到周二晚比赛很久之前的奇妙渊源。
阿森纳曾一直在其标志性的海布里球场比赛直到2006年，而弗利特伍德的球场也拥有相同的名字，这是以毗邻的街道海布里大道命名的。
弗利特伍德还身穿红色球衣和白色袖子，风格与经典的阿森纳球衣相似。没有人完全确定原因，但据镇上“国王手臂”酒吧的酒保雷·柯蒂斯称：“弗利特伍德的第一套球衣，即主场球衣，是阿森纳送给他们的。”
在2000年代，就在帕特里克·维埃拉担任阿森纳队长后不久，弗利特伍德拥有一位同名球星：一名名叫马格诺·维埃拉的巴西前锋。
周三上午，在拥有5300个座位海布里球场上，弗利特伍德为此租借的泛光灯正在被打包收起。“一切回到了现实，回到了作为一支英乙球队的状态，这才是我们的常态，”票务和零售经理佐菲亚·赖特说道。
周二的时候，兴奋和期待早早开始了。“我们开始关注什么球队来到了这里，谁飞了过来，然后传言开始出现，就像是‘哦，他们派出了相当强的阵容’，”赖特说。
“所以我们都计划着好好享受这个场合。然后很显然，我们以1比0领先，每个人都在互相对视，觉得这本不该发生。”
她说，当阿森纳扳平比分时，一切回到了现实，只是“时间一直在走，比分却没有变”。
赖特表示，在经历戏剧性的点球大战、淘汰了英超冠军和欧冠决赛队伍之后，所有人都冲上了球场。球员、球迷和管理层的下一站是球场酒吧。
“简直太不可思议了，”赖特说。“我们昨晚一直待到大约一点半。这太棒了，太神奇了。”
“气氛太疯狂了，”33岁的克里斯·纽曼说，他和儿子一起观看了这场比赛。他周三回到俱乐部商店挑选了两本纪念场刊。“一切都发生得太快了，”他说。“我完全没有想到。”
在过去的36小时里，这家商店的生意非常兴隆，其中弗利特伍德和阿森纳的半场围巾尤其受欢迎。一位带着伦敦口音的买家说：“我是热刺球迷，这太棒了。”
赖特表示，赛后第二天整个小镇都在热议：“那些苦苦挣扎的酒吧昨天开门营业到了鬼知道几点。我们只希望这种势头能持续整个赛季，希望上座率开始回升，让球场的入场人数重新恢复稳定。”
该俱乐部的绰号——鳕鱼军团、渔夫们、鳕鱼和拖网渔船队员——都源自这个兰开夏郡小镇的捕鱼业。
正在港口旁拜访鱼贩的莎伦·布鲁克斯说：“我们以为会是三比零、四比零或五比零，但他们表现得太出色了，不仅逼平了对手还在点球大战中获胜，罚进了五个精彩的点球。对弗利特伍德这样的小镇来说这很好，而且对手还是上赛季的英超冠军，他们真是让人惊艳，不是吗？”
她12岁的儿子瑞安是一名阿森纳球迷，他说：“尽管我希望阿森纳取胜，但我为他们感到高兴。”
在“国王手臂”酒吧里，大家都在热切等待周三晚上的抽签，这将决定弗利特伍德的下一个对手。
唐纳德·麦克lean因为在疗养院值班而错过了比赛，他说：“我今天早上看到了进球，我非常高兴，欣喜若狂，想象一下弗利特伍德击败了枪手！以前从未听说过，所以是的，我们对此都感到高兴。太棒了！”
鳕鱼军团的胜利让球迷们欣喜若狂，部分原因是它如此出人意料——弗利特伍德在足球联赛金字塔中比阿森纳低了84个名次。
迈克尔·霍顿表示，他曾认为这个结果是不可能的，“因为阿森纳本不该输球，不是吗？尤其不是对阵弗利特伍德。”
保罗·达格对球队的前景非常悲观，他在中场休息时下注200英镑押阿森纳以10/7的赔率取胜。“阿森纳的哲凯赖什在开场五分钟内就进球了，”他说。“我想，哦，开始了，钱要到手了。人总是要活到老学到老。”
弗利特伍德球迷希望这不仅是一场属于比赛爱好者的胜利，还能成为更大成就的开始。“小镇需要这个，”达格说。“如你所见，这里到处都是慈善商店和电子烟店。”
退休起重机操作员加里·吉尔说：“我是一名弗利特伍德球迷，我认为这对小镇来说太棒了。这会带来财富。”
“如果他们能保持昨夜那样的决心，现在任何来访的球队都会感到害怕。而通常情况下并非如此，他们会觉得这是一场轻松的胜利。”
吉姆·巴克利说：“这太神奇了。我们是一个拥有25000人口的微型小镇，这里没有火车站。我的意思是，在酋长球场，可以放下三个这样大小的小镇。”
他说得相差不远——阿森纳的主场可以容纳60000名球迷。
“国王手臂”的酒客们表示，尽管遭遇了尴尬的失利，远道而来的阿森纳球迷还是度过了愉快的一天。
达格说：“这里一品脱啤酒两英镑二十便士，街对面两英镑五十便士。他们简直不敢相信，他们一直在说，该死，我们在的地方要八英镑。”
回到港口附近的鲨鱼薯条店，午餐时间迎来了客流高峰。贝瑟尼·泰勒在盛着鳕鱼和薯条时说，她住在球场附近，从人群的欢呼声和信号弹就能猜出最终比分。“这很好，太棒了，”她补充道。“我们根本没想到。”
“这是一个令人难以置信的结果，不是吗？”她的同事路易莎·史密斯说。
但他们认为弗利特伍德能捧起联赛杯吗？“这将是一场苦战，但希望他们能做到，”史密斯说。“我们祝他们好运。”

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta’s reaction said it all. As Max Dowman trudged towards the touchline after becoming the youngest player sent off in a League Cup match at 16 years and 300 days, the Arsenal manager could not help himself.

Arms folded across his chest like an angry father who has caught his teenage son sneaking in after midnight, Arteta leaned over and aimed a few choice words in Dowman’s direction before the forward headed sheepishly down the tunnel. What he said remains unknown, although that hasn’t stopped the amateur lip-readers speculating on social media. “Get in the changing room. Now,” appears the most likely guess.

There is no doubt Arteta had made up his mind about the incident that ended with Dowman seeing red for reacting to an overaggressive sliding tackle from Fleetwood’s Harrison Neal. Although Arsenal intend to appeal and Arteta told Sky after the shock penalty shootout defeat by the League Two side 84 places below them in the pyramid that he wanted to watch it again before “assessing the situation”, the Spaniard made no excuses for Dowman in his post-match press conference.

“It was something that we discussed before the game,” he said when asked about their touchline exchange. “We knew when we prepared the context of the match, we were very clear on the things to expect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate.”

Whether Dowman’s reaction warranted a straight red card remains open to debate given there was minimal force when he lifted his right knee towards Neal. The referee, Michael Salisbury, could easily have decided to give both players a yellow and defused the situation, especially given Cole Palmer was booked for barging into Tottenham’s Matheus Fernandes off the ball on Saturday in what seemed a far more aggressive act. But, as Wayne Rooney and David Beckham infamously found to their cost while playing for England at the World Cup, acts of petulance are not usually tolerated by officials. Dowman was deemed to have overstepped the line.

It is a pressure Arteta has warned the record-breaking teenager would have to deal with as Dowman’s reputation has grown. Only last month Dowman was sent off playing for England Under-19s against the USA after a poorly timed tackle that most present at the behind-closed-doors match deemed a harsh decision. He was said to have been on the receiving end of a host of strong challenges in that match. Last year, Arteta urged Dowman to follow the example of Bukayo Saka after revealing Dowman was fouled nine times in a the first half of an England Under‑19s game against Spain.

“It’s going to happen, he’s going to have to learn when to release the ball and when to attract his starting position,” Arteta said. “Very similar to Bukayo in the beginning as well. Those players are going to attract players, contact, attention and they have to be very smart about when you want that contact and when you don’t want it, and what you have to do to avoid it.”

Asked how Dowman tends to react, he said: “He just gets up … very rare! Sometimes I get surprised emotionally how cool he can be. I think it’s about repetition. He’s so used to it that now he knows to let the referee deal with it and my teammates probably to defend me, and I will carry on playing.”

When the dust settles after a seismic defeat that ranks alongside Arsenal’s League Cup upsets against Swindon, Birmingham and Bradford, Arteta may come to regret such a public admonishment of a 16-year-old. His actions were criticised by Paul Merson, who questioned whether Areta would “do it differently” given another chance. But part of Arteta’s frustration will be that Dowman took the bait. He also knows opponents will now target Dowman even more to see whether they can provoke a reaction.

If Arsenal’s appeal fails, Dowman’s immediate punishment will be a three-match domestic suspension, causing him to miss Sunday’s trip to Liverpool and games against Hull and Newcastle. The timing is far from helpful: Saka’s thigh injury, expected to keep him out for several weeks, had opened up the possibility of more game time in the Premier League and Noni Madueke did not travel to Fleetwood owing to an ankle issue.

Dowman burst on to the scene last year by becoming the first 15-year-old to play in the Champions League, then broke the Premier League’s youngest goalscorer record against Everton in March, and this is the first major setback in his fledgling career.

He has been training with the first team since he was 14 and Arsenal have been extremely careful not to overexpose one of the most talked about players to emerge from their Hale End academy. Arteta resisted the temptation to give him many more minutes in the Premier League after Dowman scored twice against Ipswich in the previous round of the Carabao Cup last month. The challenge will be how Dowman responds to the extra scrutiny – on and off the pitch – that is bound to come his way.

items.titleZh: 马克斯·道曼与弗リート伍德的冲突让阿森纳与阿尔特塔感到尴尬
items.summaryZh: 道曼在联赛杯中染红引发关注，阿尔特塔赛后对此进行了严厉批评。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔的反应说明了一切。当16岁零300天的马克斯·道曼成为联赛杯中被罚下的最年轻球员，步履蹒跚地走向场边时，这位阿森纳主帅按捺不住自己的情绪。
阿尔特塔双臂交叉在胸前，就像一个抓到十几岁的儿子半夜偷偷溜回家的愤怒父亲，他俯身朝道曼的方向说了几句狠话，随后这位前锋灰溜溜地走进了球员通道。他说的话目前不得而知，但这并没有阻止业余唇语专家在社交媒体上进行猜测。“回更衣室去。现在，”这似乎是最有可能的猜测。
毫无疑问，阿尔特塔已经对这起事件做出了决定。此前，弗リート伍德球员哈里森·尼尔（Harrison Neal）的动作过大，道曼因做出反应而吃到红牌。尽管阿森纳打算上诉，且这家比阿森纳低84个名次的英乙球队在点球大战中爆冷淘汰阿森纳后，阿尔特塔在接受天空体育采访时表示他想先看回放再“评估形势”，但在赛后新闻发布会上，这位西班牙主帅并没有为道曼找借口。
当被问及他们场边的交流时，他说：“这是我们在赛前讨论过的事情。当我们准备这场比赛的背景时，我们对应该预料到的事情以及我们在情感上必须控制的事情非常清楚。”
考虑到道曼将右膝抬向尼尔时力量微乎其微，他的反应是否理应直接吃到红牌仍有待商榷。主裁判迈克尔·萨利斯伯里本可以轻易决定向两名球员出示黄牌以平息事态，尤其是考虑到科尔·帕尔默周六在无球状态下撞击热刺球员马特乌斯·费尔南德斯时只吃到黄牌，这看起来是一个更具侵略性的动作。但是，正如韦恩·鲁尼和大卫·贝克汉姆当年代表英格兰队参加世界杯时付出沉重代价一样，官员们通常不会容忍任性的行为。道曼被认为越界了。
阿尔特塔曾警告过这位打破纪录的少年，随着道曼名声的增长，他将不得不应对这种压力。就在上个月，道曼代表英格兰U19对阵美国队时，因一次时机不佳的铲球而被罚下场，当时在场的多数人都认为这是一次严厉的判罚。据说他在那场比赛中多次遭到凶狠的拼抢。去年，阿尔特塔敦促道曼以布卡约·萨卡为榜样，此前他透露道曼在英格兰U19对阵西班牙的上半场比赛中被侵犯了九次。
阿尔特塔说：“这种事还会发生，他必须学会什么时候出球，什么时候吸引防守位置。这和布卡约刚出道时非常相似。这些球员会吸引防守球员、身体接触和注意力，他们必须非常聪明，知道什么时候需要这种接触，什么时候不需要，以及该怎么做才能避免。”
当被问及道曼通常如何反应时，他说：“他只是站起来……非常罕见！有时他在情绪上能表现得如此冷静，这让我感到惊讶。我认为这是重复的力量。他已经习以为常，现在他知道让裁判去处理，队友大概会保护我，然后我会继续踢球。”
在一场与阿森纳此前在联赛杯对阵斯温顿、伯明翰和布拉德福德的爆冷失利相提并论的震撼失利尘埃落定之后，阿尔特塔可能会对公开斥责一名16岁球员感到后悔。他的行为受到了保罗·默森的批评，后者质疑阿尔特塔如果再有一次机会是否会“做得不同”。但阿尔特塔感到沮丧的部分原因在于道曼上了钩。他也知道，对手现在会更加针对道曼，看看能否激怒他。

推广后内容
如果阿森纳的上诉失败，道曼受到的即时惩罚将是国内禁赛三场，这将导致他错过周日对阵利物浦的比赛，以及对阵赫尔城和纽卡斯尔的比赛。这个时机非常糟糕：萨卡的腿筋受伤预计将让他缺阵数周，这本为他在英超联赛中获得更多出场时间创造了可能，而农尼·马杜埃凯由于脚踝问题并未随队前往弗リート伍德。
道曼去年崭露头角，成为在欧冠出场的最年轻15岁球员，随后在3月份对阵埃弗顿的比赛中打破了英超最年轻进球纪录，这是他刚起步的职业生涯中遭遇的第一个重大挫折。
他从14岁起就一直在随一线队训练，阿森纳一直非常小心，避免过度使用这位从黑尔端青训营走出来的备受瞩目的球员。在上个月联赛杯上一轮对阵伊普斯维奇打进两球后，阿尔特塔克制住了在英超联赛中给他更多出场时间的诱惑。接下来的挑战将是，道曼将如何应对随之而来的场内外的额外审视。

items.summaryEn: Read our head coach's thoughts ahead of the UEFA Women's Champions League game at home to Benfica
bodyEn: Before every home game, Renée Slegers gives her thoughts around the team and our upcoming game in her manager's notes published in the matchday programme.

Ahead of our UEFA Women's Champions League match at home to Benfica, the head coach speaks passionately about you - our supporters - and how you deserved victory last Saturday. Now Renée knows this is the time to start building on that momentum.

Good evening and welcome to Meadow Park for what promises to be an exciting UEFA Champions League clash with Portuguese champions Benfica. We’re excited to face a new challenge this evening and bring all the momentum from the weekend with us.

Let’s make Saturday’s success against Tottenham Hotspur the beginning of something. We have been on such a frustrating run of games and to be able to break that cycle on Saturday, at the north London derby no less, meant so much to all of us.

You all deserved that win. Your dedication to this team throughout a difficult start to the season has been nothing short of incredible and we are all so grateful for your support. We wanted to make sure you knew that.

The supporters were on our minds all week in the lead-up to the match. We’d spoken within the group about how everyone wanted to play for something bigger than themselves, and there’s no greater symbol for that than a sold-out away end of nearly 4,000 people. So we said: let’s do this for you. In times like these, actions speak louder than words.

You could see that when Leah sprinted to you the moment the final whistle blew, with Isabella Damm and Amy Liddiard right there in the crowd alongside you. Saturday was an outpouring of relief, but it was also more than that. It was a sign of the connection we share. You are all a part of this team.

There was a lot to be happy about on the pitch at the weekend, with a lot of brave performances to celebrate, but we remain pragmatic. It required another comeback to get the three points, which is a pattern we need to break free from. Saturday was a good step towards the consistency, intensity and cohesion we want to bring to every match, but it is far from mission accomplished. For this win to really mean something, we must capitalise on the energy we built together and back it up with good performances. How do we get back to being Arsenal? One game at a time.

A midweek game is good for momentum, but it also means we can’t dwell on this victory for long. Our focus has turned back to the Champions League immediately, with a familiar opposition. When we travelled to Benfica last season, I was really impressed by the team’s performance. Particularly in the first half, Benfica demanded a lot of patience from us in the final third, but through a combination of problem-solving and game-changers, we found a way to win. But we will not underestimate them.

That is such a crucial mentality because, as we’ve seen already this season, there are matches where luck isn’t on your side and dominance doesn’t automatically translate to goals. We found a way then, we found a way against Spurs, and now it’s our responsibility to maintain that.
We can’t wait to play for you again this evening. Let’s take the fight and passion from Saturday and keep it going.
Enjoy the match, and COYG!
Read more about the game, as well as a host of other fantastic content, by buying the Arsenal v Benfica programme either around the stadium or online.

items.summaryZh: 阅读主教练在欧冠主场对阵本菲卡赛前的独家寄语
bodyZh: 在每场主场比赛之前，雷妮·斯莱格斯都会在比赛日秩序册中发表主教练寄语，分享她对球队及接下来比赛的看法。
在我们的欧洲女子冠军联赛主场对阵本菲卡的比赛前，这位主教练深情地谈到了你们——我们的球迷，以及你们在上周六是如何配得上这场胜利的。现在，雷妮深知这是开始积累势头的时刻。
大家晚上好，欢迎来到美度公园球场，今晚我们将迎来一场令人期待的欧冠对决，对手是葡萄牙冠军本菲卡。我们很高兴能迎接今晚的新挑战，并将周末的势头带到比赛中。
让我们把周六对阵托特纳姆热刺的胜利当作新局面的开端。此前我们经历了一段令人沮丧的比赛，能够在周六打破这一循环，而且是在北伦敦德比中，这对我们所有人都意义重大。
你们配得上这场胜利。在赛季初遭遇艰难开局的情况下，你们对这支球队的奉献简直不可思议，我们对你们的支持充满感激。我们希望确保你们能感受到这一点。
在赛前的整整一周里，球迷们一直都在我们的心头。我们在队内讨论过每个人都想为超越自我的目标而战，而没有什么比近4000人的售罄客场看台更能象征这一点了。所以我们当时说：为了你们，我们要拿下比赛。在这样的时刻，行动胜过言语。
当终场哨响时，你们可以看到莉亚立刻冲向你们，伊莎贝拉·达姆和埃米·利迪亚德也在人群中与你们同在。周六的情感释放是一种解脱，但它不止于此。这是我们共同连接的象征。你们都是这支球队的一部分。
周末的球场上有许多令人高兴的事情，有许多勇敢的表现值得庆祝，但我们依然保持务实。我们需要再次逆转才能拿到三分，这是我们需要摆脱的模式。周六是我们朝着将稳定性、强度和凝聚力带到每场比赛迈出的好一步，但远未大功告成。为了让这场胜利真正有意义，我们必须利用我们共同建立的能量，并以出色的表现来加以印证。我们如何找回阿森纳本色？脚踏实地，一场一场来。
周中的比赛对保持势头很有利，但也意味着我们不能沉浸在这场胜利中太久。我们的注意力已经迅速转回欧冠赛场，面对一个熟悉的对手。上赛季我们客场对阵本菲卡时，球队的表现给我留下了深刻印象。特别是在上半场，本菲卡在进攻三区对我们的耐心提出了极高要求，但通过解决问题和改变比赛局势的球员，我们找到了取胜之道。不过，我们绝不会轻视他们。
这种心态至关重要，正如我们本赛季已经看到的那样，有些比赛运气不在你这边，场上优势并不一定会自动转化为进球。当时我们找到了方法，对阵热刺时我们找到了方法，现在我们的责任是保持这种状态。
我们迫不及待地想在今晚再次为你们而战。让我们将周六的斗志与激情延续下去。
享受比赛，COYG！

items.summaryEn: UEFA Women’s Champions League football returns to Meadow Park in Borehamwood for Wednesday’s visit of Benfica at 8pm.
bodyEn: UEFA Women’s Champions League football returns to Meadow Park in Borehamwood for Wednesday’s visit of Benfica at 8pm.
Tickets are on general sale for supporters looking to attend in person.
Let’s keep the positivity going after we got back to winning ways with a 2-1 victory in the north London derby on Saturday!
BOUYANT BENFICA
Our Portuguese opponents will have a spring in their step having started the season with four wins from four matches in the Campeonato Nacional Feminino as they look to retain their league title.
They’re currently just shy of Torreense on goal difference, but do have a game in hand on the league leaders.

A stubborn defence has been key to Benfica’s success so far, conceding just once in Portugal’s topflight in 2026/27. That was in Saturday’s 4-1 win at home to Sporting CP, which followed 4-0, 2-0 and 3-0 successes against Maritimo, Rio Ave and Racing Almada respectively.

They also got their Champions League campaign off to a winning start by beating Juventus 2-1 away from home, before suffering a 3-0 defeat at home to Bayern Munich, which left them tenth in the table.
Ivan Baptista’s side will be looking for a win that would see Benfica overtake us, as we’re currently fifth on four points following a 1-0 victory at home to HB Koge and a 2-2 draw away to Paris FC.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY
Slegers: “They have their identity, of course. Remember the game from last year that we played there away, they made it hard for us, we ended up winning 2-0.

“They've played their two games against Juventus and Bayern. They compete and we know that they will compete against us tomorrow as well. So there will be some similarities. They have their identity, a really robust, compact structure in the league. They've had an amazing run since 2024, I think." - Read every word of Renée’s pre-Benfica press conference.

Baptista: “Playing at home and being a team that is a contender to reach the final stages of this competition – it's natural to see them [Arsenal] as favourites to control the game, but that means very little to me as a coach.
"I think we will create many difficulties for Arsenal, just as we did a year ago at the Estadio da Luz, against a good team. It will be a good game."
TEAM NEWS

Renée said in her pre-match press conference that Katie Reid and Michelle Agyemang won't be back in time for this fixture, while Frida Maanum is progressing but tomorrow comes too soon. Kim Little, however, is back in the squad.
FACTS AND STATS
We have won 10 of our previous 13 home games in the group-league stage of the UWCL (L3), including each of our last three; each of our last six such fixtures have been decided by a single goal.
Benfica have won just three of their previous 15 away matches in the UWCL (D2 10), however, one of those victories came in their most recent such outing (2-1 at Juventus on MD1).
No side has made more interceptions in this season’s UWCL than Benfica (33, also Paris FC), while only Real Madrid (11) have intercepted fewer passes than us this term (13).

Georgia Stanway scored and assisted on her UWCL debut for us against Paris FC, just her second game with a goal and an assist in the competition after December 2022 (for Bayern v Rosengard) - Stanway has been involved in four goals in her two UWCL games against Benfica (2 goals, 2 assists), her most against an opponent.
MATCH OFFICIALS
Ivana Projkovska from North Macedonia has been appointed to take charge of Wednesday’s match, assisted by Elena Soklevska-Ilievski and Alexandra Vargova, with Sabina Bolic the Fourth Official.
Projkovska was among the officials for the 2025 Champions League final, in which we beat Barcelona 1-0 in Lisbon to become European champions for the second time in our history.
Momcilo Markovic is on VAR duties alongside Deborah Anex.
Referee: Ivana ProjkovskaAssistant Referees: Elena Soklevska-Ilievski and Alexandra VargovaFourth Official: Sabina Bolic VAR: Momcilo MarkovicAssistant VAR: Deborah Anex
HOW TO WATCH
Supporters in the UK can catch this match live on Disney +.
Check out our how to watch article for the full list of broadcasters showing the game around the world.
LAST TIME WE MET
Our first ever game against Benfica came in last season’s Champions League league phase, when we won 2-0 away from home thanks to goals from Beth Mead and Alessia Russo at Estadio da Luz.

We would go on to finish fifth in the league phase, having to reach the knockout phase by beating OH Leuven over two legs in the play-offs, before we knocked Chelsea out of the quarter-finals and were beaten by Lyon in the semis.

items.summaryZh: 欧冠女足联赛重回米多公园球场，阿森纳女足将在周三迎战本菲卡。
bodyZh: 欧冠女足联赛将于周三晚上8点重回博勒姆伍德的米多公园球场，阿森纳将在此迎战本菲卡。
门票目前正面向希望现场观战的球迷全面发售。
在上周六的北伦敦德比中，我们以2-1的比分重回胜轨，让我们把这种积极的势头延续下去！
势头正盛的本菲卡
我们的葡萄牙对手在新赛季的葡萄牙女足甲级联赛中取得开局四连胜，正力求卫冕联赛冠军，这让他们信心十足。
目前他们在净胜球上稍逊于托雷恩斯，但比领头羊少赛一场。
坚固的防守是本菲卡迄今为止成功的关键，在2026/27赛季的葡萄牙顶级联赛中他们仅失一球。那一球来自于上周六主场4-1击败葡萄牙体育的比赛中，在此之前他们分别以4-0、2-0和3-0的比分战胜了马里迪莫、里奥阿维和阿尔马达竞技。
他们的欧冠征程也取得了开门红，客场2-1击败了尤文图斯，随后主场0-3不敌拜仁慕尼黑，这使得他们在积分榜上排名第十。
伊万·巴蒂斯塔（Ivan Baptista）的球队此役若取胜将反超我们。此前我们在主场1-0战胜HB克厄、客场2-2战平巴黎FC后，目前以4分排名第五。
主教练言论
斯勒格斯：“她们当然有自己的战术风格。还记得我们去年客场与她们的比赛吗，她们给我们制造了很大困难，最终我们2-0取胜。”
“她们已经踢了两场对阵尤文图斯和拜仁的比赛。她们极具竞争力，我们知道她们明天也会对我们构成威胁。因此会有一些相似之处。她们有自己的风格，在联赛中有着非常稳固、紧凑的阵型。我认为她们自2024年以来一直保持着惊人的状态。”——阅读雷妮赛前新闻发布会的全部内容。
巴蒂斯塔：“主场作战且作为一支有实力闯入本赛事最后阶段的球队——人们自然会把阿森纳视为掌控比赛的favorites（热门），但作为一名教练，这对我来说意义不大。”
“我认为我们会给阿森纳制造很多麻烦，就像一年前在光明球场对阵这支优秀的球队时一样。这将是一场精彩的比赛。”
球队新闻
雷妮在赛前新闻发布会上表示，凯蒂·里德（Katie Reid）和米歇尔·阿吉耶芒（Michelle Agyemang）无法赶上这场比赛，而弗里达·马努姆（Frida Maanum）正在康复中，但明天的比赛对她来说为时尚早。不过，队长金·利特尔（Kim Little）已经回归大名单。
比赛数据与统计
我们在欧冠女足小组赛阶段的前13个主场比赛中赢了10场（3负），包括最近的三场全胜；我们最近的六场此类比赛都是以一球之差分出胜负。
本菲卡在欧冠女足此前的15个客场比赛中仅赢了3场（2平10负），不过其中一场胜利来自于他们最近的一次客场之旅（第一轮客场2-1击败尤文图斯）。
在本赛季的欧冠女足联赛中，没有哪支球队的拦截次数比本菲卡更多（33次，与巴黎FC并列），而本赛季只有皇家马德里（11次）的传球拦截次数比我们（13次）更少。
乔治娅·斯坦韦（Georgia Stanway）在我们对阵巴黎FC的欧冠女足首秀中贡献传射，这是她在该赛事中第二次单场完成传射，上一次还是在2022年12月（代表拜仁对阵罗森加德）——斯坦韦在面对本菲卡的2场欧冠女足比赛中参与了4个进球（2球2助攻），这是她对阵单一对手参与进球最多的纪录。
比赛官员
来自北马其顿的伊万娜·普罗伊科夫斯卡（Ivana Projkovska）被指派担任周三比赛的主裁判，助理裁判为埃莱娜·索克列夫斯卡-伊利耶夫斯基（Elena Soklevska-Ilievski）和亚历山德拉·瓦尔戈娃（Alexandra Vargova），第四官员为萨比娜·博利奇（Sabina Bolic）。
普罗伊科夫斯卡曾担任2025年欧冠决赛的裁判之一，当时我们在里斯本1-0击败巴塞罗那，历史上第二次成为欧洲冠军。
蒙奇洛·马尔科维奇（Momcilo Markovic）将担任VAR裁判，德博拉·阿内克斯（Deborah Anex）担任助理VAR。
裁判：伊万娜·普罗伊科夫斯卡，助理裁判：埃莱娜·索克列夫斯卡-伊利耶夫斯基和亚历山德拉·瓦尔戈娃，第四官员：萨比娜·博利奇，VAR：蒙奇洛·马尔科维奇，助理VAR：德博拉·阿内克斯
如何观赛
英国的球迷可以通过 Disney + 观看本场比赛的现场直播。
查看我们的观赛指南文章，获取全球转播该场比赛的电视台完整列表。
上次交锋
我们与本菲卡的历史首次交锋是在上赛季的欧冠联赛阶段，当时我们凭借贝丝·米德（Beth Mead）和阿莱西亚·鲁索（Alessia Russo）在光明球场的进球，客场2-0取胜。
我们最终在联赛阶段排名第五，在附加赛中两回合击败OH卢瓦尔晋级淘汰赛阶段，随后在四分之一决赛中淘汰了切尔西，但在半决赛中不敌里昂。

items.summaryEn: Manager Lawlor reflects on ‘unbelievably special’ nightArsenal youngster sent off for retaliation before shootout Fleetwood’s manager, Matt Lawlor, hailed the club’s victory as one for all football after his side shocked the Premier League champions, Arsenal, on penalties in the Carabao Cup. bodyEn: Fleetwood’s manager, Matt Lawlor, hailed the club’s victory as one for all football after his side shocked the Premier League champions, Arsenal, on penalties in the Carabao Cup. The side 18th in League Two held their nerve in the shootout, Conor Haughey hitting the winner to reach the quarter-finals.

The goalkeeper, Jay Lynch, was Fleetwood’s other hero, saving from Bruno Guimarães to set up the chance for victory. Aaron Loupalo‑Bi and Viktor Gyökeres ensured it finished 1-1 in normal time, but Arsenal ended up a man light after Max Dowman was shown a red card for reacting to a challenge.

Asked if Fleetwood’s win was the story of the season, Lawlor said: “Yeah, I hope so. Football’s getting a little bit more, I don’t know, clinical and sanitised. And that to me there was that feeling that we all get as football fans. That was what you kind of live for, isn’t it? To be a part of it is special. To be giving that to football fans, and especially Fleetwood fans, is unbelievably special. And yeah, something that I’m really proud of.”

Lawlor was clearly emotional at full-time as many of the 4,000 home supporters streamed on to the pitch to celebrate beating a team 84 places above them. “I was trying to not cry and I didn’t. I’ve managed to hold it,” he said. “My family, my little boy here, we’re all local. I was turning around and people were screaming at me in the crowd and people that I knew and grew up with, that I went to school with or they’ve got a loose connection, and people that jumped out on to the pitch.
“That’s really special and really emotional. To do something that special early in my career as well, it’s an emotional night. It is emotional. Emotional for the players, emotional for me.”

This was Dowman’s second red card of the month, having been sent off for England Under-19s, providing a steep learning curve for the talented teenager. Mikel Arteta was clearly unimpressed:“When we prepare the context of the match, we were very clear on the things you expect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate.
“It was very clear,” added Arteta, who appeared to aim criticism at Dowman as he walked past him after being sent off.

items.titleZh: 弗利特伍德点球大战淘汰阿森纳，主帅劳勒盛赞这是足球的胜利
items.summaryZh: 弗利特伍德在联赛杯点球击败阿森纳晋级八强，主帅劳勒盛赞这是一个特别的夜晚。
bodyZh: 在联赛杯中点球爆冷击败英超冠军阿森纳后，弗利特伍德主教练马特·劳勒盛赞这场胜利属于所有热爱足球的人。这支英乙排名第18位的球队在点球大战中顶住压力，康纳·霍吉罚入制胜球，帮助球队闯入八强。
门将杰伊·林奇是弗利特伍德的另一位英雄，他扑出了布鲁诺·吉马良斯的点球，为胜利奠定了基础。阿隆·卢帕洛-比和维克托·哲凯赖什常规时间各进一球战成1-1，但马克斯·多曼因对拼抢做出反应被红牌罚下，导致阿森纳少一人作战。
当被问及弗利特伍德的胜利是否是本赛季的最大新闻时，劳勒说：“是的，我希望如此。足球变得越来越有些严谨和流于表面。对我来说，那种感觉正是我们所有球迷所追求的。这就是你活着的意义，不是吗？能成为其中一部分很特别。能将这一点带给球迷，尤其是弗利特伍德球迷，简直是不可思议的特别。是的，这让我感到非常自豪。”
终场哨响时，劳勒显然情绪激动，多达4000名主场球迷涌入球场庆祝击败一支排名比他们高出84位的球队。“我一直在努力不哭，我成功忍住了，”他说，“我的家人、我年幼的儿子都在这里，我们都是本地人。我转过身，人群中有我认识的、一起长大的、一起上学的人在对我尖叫，还有涌入球场的人们。”
“这真的很特别，也很情绪化。在我职业生涯的早期就能做到如此特别的事情，这是一个令人激动的夜晚。确实很激动。对球员来说很激动，对我也很激动。”
这是多曼本月吃到的第二张红牌，此前他曾在代表英格兰U19队比赛时被罚下，这为这位才华横溢的年轻人上了一堂深刻的成长课。米克尔·阿尔特塔显然很不满意：“当我们为比赛做准备时，我们对你所期望的事情、在情感上我们必须掌控的事情非常清楚。”
阿尔特塔补充道：“这非常清楚。”在多曼被罚下场从他身边走过时，阿尔特塔似乎对其实施了批评。

items.titleEn: Every word from Mikel Arteta's post-Fleetwood presser
items.summaryEn: Read everything Mikel said after our trip to Highbury in the Carabao Cup fourth round
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has spoken to the press following our defeat on penalties to Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup fourth round.
The 10-player Gunners lost out 5-3 on spot-kicks at Highbury Stadium, after a 1-1 draw inside 90 minutes during which Viktor Gyokeres netted his first of the season.
We now switch our attention to Sunday's huge Premier League clash against Liverpool at Anfield.
Here's every word from the boss following Tuesday's tie:

on his reflection of the night:First of all, congratulations to Fleetwood. In the manner they did it, the atmosphere they created. I have nothing to fault the players for their attitude and intensity throughout the game, with 11 and with 10, but when you are playing in that superior way, you have to give nothing to the opponent. When we create the volume of shots and chances we did, you have to score three, four or five. You capitalise on it. If you don’t, there are no margins, and that’s the reality. Then you have to wait and get through the round on penalties, and we didn’t do that. The probability was low with the way the game was panning out, but it’s football and still with low probability, there is always a chance you could be out of the cup.

on Max Dowman’s red card:I haven’t seen it back, and with the camera you can’t really see what happens. The decision was made by the referee, and that’s it. Even with 10 men, we had three big chances to score.

on whether Max’s talent could see him targeted by opponents:We know when we prepare the context of the match, we’re very clear on what to expect. Emotionally, we have to dominate, but we’re very clear.
on what he said to Max on the sideline:It’s something that we discussed before the game.

on the ‘magic’ of English football through these cup competitions:This competition and football in this country is like this. The belief and conviction people have is because there is a history related to it. Unfortunately, we didn’t want to go through this - we are extremely sad - but at the same time, we need to congratulate the opponent.

on any potential injuries or selection regrets among the absent players:No, Calafiori was out, Noni was out with an ankle, and Declan was feeling a problem the other day, which is why I had to substitute him.
on any prior conversations with Max about being fouled regularly:We’re not going to discuss that here and now.

items.summaryZh: 阅读米克尔在联赛杯第四轮对阵弗利特伍德赛后的采访。
bodyZh: 在联赛杯第四轮点球大战不敌弗利特伍德镇后，米克尔·阿尔特塔接受了媒体采访。
在海布里球场常规时间战成1-1平后，少一人作战的阿森纳在点球大战中以3-5落败，维克托·哲凯赖什打入了本赛季个人的首粒进球。
我们现在将注意力转向周日英超联赛中客场对阵利物浦的焦点大战。
以下是主教练在周二比赛后的全部言论：

谈对当晚比赛的反思：首先，祝贺弗利特伍德。以他们展现的方式，他们营造的氛围。对于球员们在整场比赛中的态度和强度，无论是11人还是10人应战，我都无可挑剔。但当你占据绝对优势时，你不能给对手任何机会。当我们创造出那么多的射门和机会时，你必须打进三、四个甚至五个球，把优势转化为胜势。如果你做不到，就没有容错空间，这就是现实。然后你只能去通过点球大战决出胜负，而我们没能做到。从比赛的走势来看，这种结果的概率很低，但这就是足球，即使概率再低，你依然有被淘汰的可能。
谈马克斯·道曼的红牌：我还没回看录像，而且通过镜头也确实看不清发生了什么。这是裁判作出的决定，就是这样。即使在只剩10人的情况下，我们也有三次绝佳的进球机会。
谈马克斯的天赋是否会让他成为对手针对的目标：我们在准备比赛时，对会发生什么非常清楚。在情绪上我们必须掌控局面，但我们心里很有数。
谈他在场边对马克斯说了什么：这是我们在赛前讨论过的事情。
谈通过这些杯赛体现出的英格兰足球的“魅力”：这项赛事和这个国家的足球就是这样。人们拥有这种信念和执着是因为这里有着相关的历史。遗憾的是，我们并不想经历这样的结果——我们极其悲伤，但与此同时，我们需要祝贺对手。
谈缺阵球员的潜在伤情或选人用人是否后悔：没有，卡拉菲奥里缺阵，诺尼脚踝受伤缺阵，赖斯前几天感觉身体有点问题，这也是我不得不把他换下的原因。
谈此前是否与马克斯交流过经常被侵犯的问题：我们现在不在这里讨论这个。

items.titleEn: Arteta: "We need to take this on the chin"
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta gave his view on our clash with Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup fourth round
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta said we need to take our loss to Fleetwood Town on the chin after exiting the Carabao Cup in the fourth round.
We fought back from a goal down against the League Two side through Viktor Gyokeres but we eventually exited on penalties.
After the game, the boss congratulated Fleetwood and said we need feel the pain of the loss before moving onto our match with Liverpool on Sunday.

He said: "First of all, congratulations to Fleetwood for going into the next round. Obviously, a really sad day for us. There’s nothing to criticise the players for in terms of their attitude, their application, their determination to go and play the game that we had to play, but obviously we conceded that really poor goal to start with and gave them some belief.

"After that, we started to attack, have many chances, and the volume of balls that we had, shots and situations, clear-cut chances that we didn’t put away. If you don’t capitalise at this level, it’s the competition you are in and you are out, there are no margins for error.

"We need to take it now on the chin. We are out of the competition, we’re very sad for all the people as well here who came to watch the game - I wanted to give them the victory. Now we need to recover, and get ready for Anfield."
Almost 1,000 Gunners travelled to the north west for the match, and Mikel thanked them for their support as we start a run of three straight away matches.
He said: "They are always with us. That’s unquestionable, after the game they showed their appreciation to the team, and we’ll try to make them very happy against Liverpool."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔：“我们需要坦然接受失利”
items.summaryZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔谈到了联赛杯第四轮对阵弗利特镇的比赛。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，在联赛杯第四轮出局后，我们需要坦然接受输给弗利特镇的结果。
面对这支英乙球队，我们凭借维克托·哲凯赖什的进球一度扳平比分，但最终在点球大战中失利。
赛后，主教练向弗利特镇表示祝贺，并表示我们需要先感受这场失利的痛苦，然后专注于周日对阵利物浦的比赛。
他说：“首先，祝贺弗利特镇晋级下一轮。显然，这对我们来说是极其难过的一天。球员们的态度、投入度以及对比赛的决心无可挑剔，但显然我们一开始丢了一个非常不应该的球，给了对方便利和信念。”
“在那之后，我们开始进攻，创造了许多机会，我们有大量的传中、射门以及绝佳机会却没有把握住。如果你在这个级别没有把握住机会，这就是你所处的赛事，你就会被淘汰，这里没有犯错的余地。”
“我们现在必须坦然接受这一切。我们已经出局了，对于所有来到现场观看比赛的人来说，我们也感到非常难过——我本想带给他们一场胜利。现在我们需要恢复体能，为安菲尔德的比赛做好准备。”
将近一千名阿森纳球迷前往西北部观看这场比赛，米克尔对他们的支持表示了感谢，因为我们将开启连续三个客场之旅。
他说：“他们一直和我们在一起。这是毫无疑问的，赛后他们表达了对球队的感谢，我们将努力在对阵利物浦时让他们感到快乐。”

items.titleEn: Odegaard: "We were not at our level"
items.summaryEn: Martin Odegaard spoke to us after our defeat against Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup
bodyEn: Martin Odegaard said we were not at our level as we exited the Carabao Cup fourth round at the hands of Fleetwood Town.
Our skipper came on at half-time after we had fallen behind to an Aaron Luopalo-Bi effort, but helped force the issue as we equalised through Viktor Gyokeres.
But we couldn't make our dominance count as the game went to penalties, where we lost 5-3 on spot kicks at Highbury.
After the game, Odegaard said: "It's very frustrating to go out. Obviously, the way we’ve played was not on the level. We need to do much, much better than we did today.
"Frustrating, but congratulations to Fleetwood and we look forward to the next game already and bounce back.

"They did well so we have to give them credit, but I think today was about us not being on our level, we need to do better. I thought we improved during the game, but again, we need to step up even more - so that’s a shame."
The games are coming thick and fast, and we turn our attention to facing Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday - and the captain said there's no time to dwell on the defeat.
"We can't feel sorry for ourselves," he said.
"We need to move on - we have a big game at the weekend, so bouncing back at the weekend is all we can do now.
Lastly, Martin thanked our travelling support, saying: "Massive thanks to them again for travelling - it’s a long journey - just thank you, and sorry for the result."

items.titleZh: 厄德高：“我们没有达到应有的水平”
items.summaryZh: 厄德高在卡拉宝杯失利后接受采访，坦言球队表现未达预期。
bodyZh: 厄德高表示，我们在卡拉宝杯第四轮负于弗利特伍德镇出局，是因为我们的表现没有达到应有的水平。
此前我们因阿隆·卢奥帕洛-比的进球而落后，队长在半场替补登场，随后通过助攻维克托·哲凯赖什扳平比分。
但我们未能将优势转化为胜势，比赛进入点球大战，最终我们在海布里以 3-5 的点球比分落败。
赛后，厄德高表示：“被淘汰令人非常沮丧。显然，我们今天的踢球方式没有达到应有的水平。我们需要比今天做得好得多。”
“这很令人沮丧，但恭喜弗利特伍德，我们已经开始期待下一场比赛并重整旗鼓了。”
“他们表现得很好，所以我们必须称赞他们，但我认为今天的问题在于我们没有发挥出自己的水平，我们需要做得更好。我认为我们在比赛中有所改善，但话说回来，我们需要进一步提升——所以这很遗憾。”
比赛一场接一场，我们将注意力转向周日前往安菲尔德对阵利物浦的比赛，队长表示现在没有时间纠结于这场失利。
“我们不能顾影自怜，”他说。
“我们需要继续前进——我们在周末有一场大战，所以在周末反弹是我们现在能做的全部。”
最后，马丁感谢了随队出征的球迷，他说道：“再次非常感谢他们随队远征——这是一段漫长的旅程——只想说谢谢，并为这个结果感到抱歉。”

items.titleEn: Fleetwood Town stun Arsenal on penalties: Carabao Cup fourth round – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Fourth-tier Fleetwood produced one of the League Cup’s biggest ever shocks, defeating the champions 5-3 on penalties after a 1-1 drawHere’s the Fleetwood head coach, Matt Lawlor: “We’ve had to make changes, with the champions in town. But we’ve got a plan with substitutions to manage the game. Arsenal have paid us a lot of respect by naming such a strong team … it’s a very difficult challenge, but one we should enjoy, and not be overawed.”“I was just thinking, with the two Highburys – I can only think of the St James(’) Parks (Exeter and Newcastle), but are there any other grounds with very similar names?” asks Shaun T. Continue reading...
bodyEn: I’ll leave you with Will Unwin’s report from Highbury, where it won’t be a quiet night at the library. Thanks for joining me. Night!

Next up for Arsenal: another tricky trip to the northwest, this time to Anfield, where Liverpool await. Then it’s back to the Champions League, against Slavia Prague. As for Fleetwood, it’s Bristol Rovers on Saturday, then Rochdale in the FA Cup.

Well, that was a strange interview. I can understand Arteta not wanting to go nuclear – Arsenal could easily have nicked a late winner, and this defeat isn’t going to make or break their season. Still, I’m not sure Fleetwood were tremendously lucky to take the game to penalties, and Arsenal having more chances is surely the bare minimum their manager should expect.
On the Dowman red card, Arteta says he will “watch it back properly and assess the situation”. Will he learn from this? “We all learn from everything, yeah.”
He says there was “no problem with attitude” in his team: “if there was, I’d be out here, absolutely fuming.” He says he feels sad, rather than angry, because his team did enough to win the game.

Here’s Mikel Arteta: “First of all, I congratulate Fleetwood for getting through. I cannot fault the effort of the players, we had so many chances, so many shots … it shouldn’t have come down to penalties.”

“They went ahead, [but] we gave them almost nothing all game, didn’t capitalise on the chances we had and then it comes down to such small margins … that’s the beauty of football, [but] it’s a very sad day.”
“The football cods are smiling down on Fleetwood,” says Peter Oh. Ian Sargeant adds: So much for West Ham being the last team to beat Arsenal at Highbury.”

More from Matt Lawlor: any plans for the rest of the evening? “We’ve got the day off … we’ll leave the cars parked at the training ground!” Who do they want next? “Another big tie will help, for a club in our position … is it the quarter-finals next? I don’t even know!”
What a great interview. He clearly prepared in great detail for this game, but never dreamed his team could actually win. I sense Arteta may not be quite so jovial.
Here’s Matt Lawlor, the Fleetwood manager. “I’ve just told the players to enjoy it, but we’ve got a game on Saturday,” he chuckles. “I didn’t want to tell them!”

“We’re not stupid enough to think we’re going to outplay the best team in the country. We just tried to deny them space, deny them opportunities. I’m so glad the lads put that performance in – they’ve made everyone in the town so proud.”

Were they prepared for penalties? “We haven’t practiced once!” Lawlor admits. “A 19-year-old centre-back took the last one, and buried it! We were deep, in a low block … I forgot we were going straight to penalties, I was worried about extra time!”

Some dates for your diary, Fleetwood fans. The quarter-final draw takes place on Wednesday, after Liverpool v Chelsea. The last-eight ties will take place in the week starting 14 December; the Cods and Bradford City will be the only non-Premier League teams in the draw.

“The star of the show was clearly the little girl with a giant sparkly hat and a Fleetwood scarf on her dad’s shoulders to the right of the goal, where the penalty kicks were taken,” writes Kari Tulinius. “What a night she’s having! She’ll remember that for the rest of her life.”

Jay Lynch talks to Sky! “My voice has gone! The whole team was magnificent, every one of them. We took heart from Grimsby beating Manchester United last season, it felt comparable. It means so much to the whole town.”
Conor Haughey is asked to describe his winning spot-kick. In a broad Ulster accent, he says: “I smashed it in and then ran like fuck.” Lovely stuff.

Fans pour onto the pitch as Fleetwood players run to embrace their kids on the touchline. The Captain Pugwash theme blares from the PA. The manager, Matt Lawlor, has tears in his eyes – he can’t believe what he’s just seen. Neither can I.

Fleetwood are into the quarter-finals, beating a team 84 places above them in the pyramid – and in reality, the gulf is even bigger than that. Cup football, eh? They’ve tried to kill it, but the magic will never die.
It’s centre-back Conor Haughey who steps up … and smashes it into the top corner. Fleetwood, 18th in League Two, have dumped Arsenal out of the Carabao Cup!
LYNCH SAVES GUIMARAES’ PENALTY!
Fleetwood 4-3 Arsenal: Lynch gets down to palm away Bruno Guimaraes’ poor effort, and Fleetwood might just have done this …
Cannon scores! Fleetwood 4-3 Arsenal
Of course he does. Seven clinical penalties dispatched so far …
Gyokeres scores! Fleetwood 3-3 Arsenal
Straightforward stuff from Gyokeres, who blooters it into the top corner.
Davies scores! Fleetwood 3-2 Arsenal
The breeze whips up, nudging the ball off the spot – but Will Davies is unfazed, whipping the ball in the opposite direction as Meslier dives to his left.
Havertz scores! Fleetwood 2-2 Arsenal
Kai Havertz, waster of many chances tonight, sends Lynch the wrong way to level things up.
Neal scores! Fleetwood 2-1 Arsenal
Perhaps Fleetwood’s best player on the night, Harrison Neal steps up … and belts it into the roof of the net!
Odegaard scores! Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal
Right in the corner, beyond Lynch’s despairing dive.
Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal: Coughlan strokes the ball into the corner to open the shootout, with Meslier going the wrong way.
Here we go, then. Because of Dowman’s red card, one Fleetwood player has to sit this out – it’s Jake Batty who draws the short (or long?) straw.
Fasten your seatbelts – we’re going to penalties.
94 mins: At the other end, Rooney’s cross is shanked into the air by Ben White, and Meslier can’t keep it in play. Corner … headed away by Konsa at the near post.
93 mins: Eze miscontrols the ball but is then brought down, and Arsenal have a free kick. It’s worked to Guimaraes, who floats the ball … straight into Lynch’s gloves.
92 mins: Another chance! Eze gets another chance to whip the ball in and find Havertz, whose downward header spins wide of goal!
91 mins: Another save from Lynch, this time tipping Odegaard’s swerving effort away. Havertz appealed for a penalty, and there’s another shout for handball as Eze’s cross hits Haughey.
90 mins: Huge save! It looks like Arsenal have got out of jail here, with Ben White unmarked and shooting on goal from eight yards out … but Lynch repels it at his near post!

88 mins: Andy Cannon was also booked in that skirmish, while Mikel Arteta did not look remotely impressed with Dowman as he trudged off, offering only a frosty word or two in the teenager’s direction.

There’s a scuffle between Dowman and Neal near the halfway line, and the Arsenal youngster appears to strike out after a hefty challenge. There’s an almighty melee before Michael Salisbury intervenes … and sends Max Dowman off! It looks harsh on first view, but Arsenal will have to see this out with 10 men.
83 mins: Oof! Andy Cannon can see the headlines, but his header is blocked by Meslier and from the rebound, the keeper is down quickly to block Will Davies’ shot from a tight angle.
82 mins: For Arsenal, Bruno Guimaraes and Ezri Konsa replace Zubimendi and Lewis-Skelly. Will Davies is on for Fleetwood, in place of goalscorer Loupalo-Bi.
81 mins: Eze fires an aimless effort into a wall of red shirts, then is flagged offside when the ball comes back to him. Some more changes coming up …
79 mins: A sniff of a half-chance for Loupalo-Bi as he breaks into the Arsenal half, but Mosquera shakes him off the ball before Coughlan can catch up.
FT: Bradford 2-0 Peterborough The League One promotion-chasers are into the quarter-final draw. Can Fleetwood join them? Ten-odd minutes to go …
76 mins: It’s full attack-v-defence now, but Ben White releases the pressure by wandering offside. Behind the Fleetwood goal, we can see a solitary lad watching from his bedroom window.
74 mins: Odegaard’s delivery is half-dealt with, before Havertz crunches a cross into the side netting.
73 mins: It’s time! Andy Cannon is on, replacing Mark Helm. There’s a free kick to deal with before any heroics, with Batty booked for hauling Dowman down.
72 mins: It’s played short and Dowman goes for goal, but his effort from 18 yards is held by Lynch at the near post.
71 mins: The Fleetwood fans are still in fine voice, with chants for Rooney, Coughlin and “boring, boring Arsenal” – who have won a corner after Lewis-Skelly’s shot was blocked.
70 mins: Arsenal deal with the corner when Batty steps offside, but the clock keeps ticking, and penalties are now just over 20 minutes away.

68 mins: Coughlan has been in decent goalscoring form and makes his presence felt straight away, jostling the Arsenal centre-backs and earning a throw-in. There’s also a bit of afters between the towering Shaun Rooney and Odegaard, who does a good job of not looking scared.
66 mins: And a change for Arsenal, with Eberechi Eze replacing O’Neill, who set up the equaliser as part of a very promising performance.
65 mins: Ched Evans and Crispin McLean are going off, replaced by two Irish players – striker Ronan Coughlan and midfielder Adam Murphy.

items.titleZh: 弗リート伍德镇点球大战爆冷淘汰阿森纳：联赛杯第四轮比赛实录
items.summaryZh: 第四级别球队弗リート伍德镇在点球大战中以5比3击败阿森纳，创造了联赛杯历史上的最大冷门之一。
bodyZh: 我将以Will Unwin发自海布里的报道结束今天的直播，今晚这里的图书馆可不会安静。感谢大家的陪伴，晚安！
阿森纳的下一场比赛：又是一场艰难的西北远征，这次他们将做客安菲尔德对阵利物浦。随后他们将回到欧冠赛场迎战布拉格斯拉维亚。至于弗リート伍德镇，他们周六将对阵布里斯托尔流浪者，然后将在足总杯中对阵罗奇代尔。
好吧，这是一场奇怪的采访。我可以理解阿尔特塔不想反应过度——阿森纳本可以轻松在最后时刻绝杀，而这场失利也不会决定他们的赛季成败。不过，我不确定弗リート伍德镇把比赛拖入点球大战纯粹靠的是运气，而阿森纳创造更多机会绝对是他们主帅应该达到的最低要求。
关于道曼的红牌，阿尔特塔表示他将“好好回看录像并评估形势”。他会从中吸取教训吗？“我们从所有事情中都能学到东西，是的。”
他说他的球队“在态度上没有问题”：“如果有的话，我会站在这里大发雷霆了。”他说他感到难过，而不是愤怒，因为他的球队表现得足以赢得比赛。
米克尔·阿尔特塔说道：“首先，我祝贺弗リート伍德镇晋级。我不能挑剔球员们的努力，我们创造了那么多机会、那么多射门……本来不该进入点球大战的。”
“他们领先了，[但]我们整场比赛几乎没给他们什么机会，却没有把握住我们创造的机会，然后比赛就取决于微小的差距……这就是足球的魅力，[但]这是非常悲伤的一天。”
“足球之神在保佑弗リート伍德镇，”彼得·奥（Peter Oh）说道。伊安·萨金特（Ian Sargeant）补充道：“说什么西汉姆联是最后一支在海布里击败阿森纳的球队，简直是个笑话。”
马特·劳勒（Matt Lawlor）的更多采访内容：对剩下的时间有什么安排？“我们今天放假……我们会把车停在训练基地！”他们下一轮想对阵谁？“对于我们这个位置的俱乐部来说，另一场大战会有所帮助……下一轮是四分之一决赛吗？我甚至都不知道！”
多棒的采访啊。他显然为这场比赛做了非常详细的准备，但从未梦想过他的球队真的能赢。我感觉阿尔特塔可能没那么高兴。
这是弗リート伍德镇主帅马特·劳勒。“我刚刚告诉球员们好好享受，但我们周六还有一场比赛，”他笑着说，“我本不想告诉他们的！”
“我们还没蠢到认为自己能击败国内最好的球队。我们只是试图剥夺他们的空间，剥夺他们的机会。我很高兴小伙子们踢出了这样的表现——他们让全镇的人都感到骄傲。”
他们为点球大战做好准备了吗？劳勒承认：“我们连一次都没练习过！”“一个19岁的中后卫罚进了最后一个点球！我们当时站位很深，摆出低位防守……我忘了我们要直接踢点球，我还在担心加时赛呢！”
弗リート伍德镇的球迷们，记下几个重要日期吧。四分之一决赛的抽签仪式将于周三利物浦对阵切尔西的比赛后举行。八强战将于12月14日开始的那一周进行；神射手队（The Cods）和布拉德福德城将是抽签中仅有的两支非英超球队。
卡里·图利纽斯（Kari Tulinius）写道：“全场的明星显然是坐在她爸爸肩膀上的那个小女孩，她戴着巨大的闪光帽子，在进球右侧的球门旁围着弗リート伍德镇的围巾。”“她今晚过得太棒了！她一辈子都会记住这一晚的。”
杰伊·林奇（Jay Lynch）接受天空体育采访！“我的嗓子哑了！全队都太棒了，每一个人都是。我们从上赛季格林斯比镇击败曼联中受到了鼓舞，感觉很相似。这对整个小镇意义重大。”
康纳·霍伊（Conor Haughey）被要求描述他制胜的点球。他带着浓重的阿尔斯特口音说：“我一脚怒射，然后像他妈的疯了一样跑了起来。”太棒了。
球迷们涌入球场，弗リート伍德镇的球员们跑向边线拥抱他们的孩子。公共广播系统里播放着《小木偶帕格沃什船长》的主题曲。主帅马特·劳勒眼里含着泪水——他不敢相信自己刚刚看到的一切。我也不敢相信。
弗リート伍德镇晋级四分之一决赛，击败了一支在联赛体系中比他们高出84位的球队——而实际上，这之间的鸿沟还要更大。这就是杯赛足球，不是吗？他们曾试图抹杀它，但它的魔力永远不会消逝。
是中后卫康纳·霍伊站了出来了……一脚怒射轰入球门右上角。英乙排名第18位的弗リート伍德镇将阿森纳淘汰出了联赛杯！
林奇扑出了吉马良斯的点球！
弗リート伍德镇 4-3 阿森纳：林奇倒地扑出了布鲁诺·吉马良斯的糟糕射门，弗リート伍德镇可能已经稳操胜券了……
坎农罚进！弗リート伍德镇 4-3 阿森纳
他当然能罚进。目前为止主罚的七个点球都干净利落地罚进了……
约克雷斯罚进！弗リート伍德镇 3-3 阿森纳
约克雷斯罚得很干脆，一脚怒射将球轰入球门右上角。
戴维斯罚进！弗リート伍德镇 3-2 阿森纳
微风大作，把球从罚球点吹开——但威尔·戴维斯镇定自若，在梅利耶向左扑救的同时将球兜入球门另一侧。
哈弗茨罚进！弗リート伍德镇 2-2 阿森纳
今晚错失良机的凯·哈弗茨骗过了林奇，将比分扳平。
尼尔罚进！弗リート伍德镇 2-1 阿森纳
作为今晚弗リート伍德镇表现最好的球员之一，哈里森·尼尔站了出来……一脚劲射轰入球门顶端！
厄德高罚进！弗リート伍德镇 1-1 阿森纳
皮球直奔死角，越过了绝望扑救的林奇。
弗リート伍德镇 1-0 阿森纳：科夫兰将球推入死角为点球大战首开纪录，梅利耶判断错了方向。
那么，开始了。由于道曼的红牌，弗リート伍德镇必须有一名球员轮休——杰克·巴蒂抽到了短（或长？）签。
系好安全带——我们要进入点球大战了。
94分钟：在另一端，鲁尼的传中被本·怀特解围到空中，梅利耶没能将球留在场内。角球……被孔萨在近门柱头球解围。
93分钟：埃泽停球失误随后被放倒，阿森纳获得任意球。球传给了吉马良斯，他将球吊入……正好落入林奇的手套中。
92分钟：又一次机会！埃泽再次获得传中找到哈弗茨的机会，后者的头球攻门偏出了球门底线外！
91分钟：林奇再次做出扑救，这次他扑出了厄德高带弧线的射门。哈弗茨此前在禁区内倒地索要点球，而当埃泽的传中击中霍伊时，场上又响起了一声手球的呼喊。
90分钟：神扑！阿森纳看起来在这里死里逃生了，本·怀特在无人防守的情况下在码外起脚射门……但林奇在近门柱将球挡出！
88分钟：安迪·坎农在那次冲突中也被黄牌警告，而米克尔·阿尔特塔对蹒跚离场的道曼看起来一点也不满意，只对这名少年说了寥寥几句冷冰冰的话。
道曼和尼尔在中线附近发生冲突，这名阿森纳小将在激烈的拼抢后似乎有报复动作。在迈克尔·索尔兹伯里介入之前发生了一场大混战……并将马克斯·道曼罚下！初看之下这个判罚有点严厉，但阿森纳不得不以10人应战撑到最后。
83分钟：哎呀！安迪·坎农看到了头条新闻在向他招手，但他的头球攻门被梅利耶挡出，随后这位门将迅速倒地封堵了威尔·戴维斯小角度的射门。
82分钟：阿森纳方面，布鲁诺·吉马良斯和埃兹里·孔萨替换下了祖比门迪和刘易斯-斯凯利。威尔·戴维斯替补登场替下了进球功臣卢帕洛-比。
81分钟：埃泽毫无目的地将球射向红衣人墙，随后在球回到他脚下时被判越位。还有更多换人即将到来……
79分钟：卢帕洛-比突破进入阿森纳半场时获得了一次半单刀机会，但在科夫兰赶到之前，莫斯克拉将球断下。
全场比赛结束：布拉德福德 2-0 彼得伯勒。这支英甲冲超球队晋级四分之一决赛抽签。弗リート伍德镇能加入他们的行列吗？还有十来分钟……
76分钟：现在完全成了进攻对防守的演练，但本·怀特因越位缓解了压力。在弗リート伍德镇球门后面，我们可以看到一个孤独的男孩正从他的卧室窗户观看比赛。
74分钟：厄德高的传中被半解围，随后哈弗茨一脚抽射打在了边网上。
73分钟：时机到了！安迪·坎农替补登场，换下马克·赫尔姆。在进行任何英雄壮举之前，他们还得先处理一个任意球，巴蒂因放倒道曼而被黄牌警告。
72分钟：战术角球开出，道曼起脚攻门，但他码外的射门被林奇在近门柱稳稳抱住。
71分钟：弗リート伍德镇的球迷依然在引吭高歌，高喊着鲁尼、科夫兰的名字以及“无聊的阿森纳”——此前刘易斯-斯凯利的射门被封堵，阿森纳获得了一个角球。
70分钟：阿森纳化解了这个角球，巴蒂随后被判越位，时间在一分一秒流逝，距离点球大战还有20多分钟。
68分钟：科夫兰保持着不错的进球状态，他一上场就展现了自己的存在感，与阿森纳中后卫激烈拼抢并赢得了一个界外球。身材高大的肖恩·鲁尼和厄德高之间也发生了一些小摩擦，厄德高很好地控制了自己的情绪，显得毫不畏惧。
66分钟：阿森纳做出换人调整，埃贝雷奇·埃泽替换下奥尼尔，后者此前表现相当出色并策动了扳平比分的进球。
65分钟：切德·埃文斯和克里斯平·麦克林离场，被两名爱尔兰球员替换下场——前锋罗南·科夫兰和中场亚当·墨菲。

bodyEn: It is more than 20 years since Arsenal played at Highbury but their trip to League Two Fleetwood – and a stadium of the same name – did not bring back fond memories as they were dumped out of the Carabao Cup on penalties. It was the team with red shirts and white sleeves that triumphed, but on this occasion it caused one of the greatest upsets in English football history.

Aaron Loupalo-Bi and Viktor Gyökeres exchanged goals in normal time but Arsenal were unable to find a winner, despite being the dominant force, as Fleetwood battled to the end. The home manager, Matt Lawlor, was almost in tears, unable to cope after the tension was released when Conor Haughey smashed the ball into the top corner to settle the shootout.

That came after Jay Lynch had saved from Bruno Guimarães, a former warehouse worker stopping the Brazilian international. It is the storylines everyone wants but so rarely gets in the sanitised modern football world.

Fleetwood were aiming to earn £400,000 from the night but got something priceless in the end. Everyone in attendance will never forget they saw the fourth-tier side knock out the Premier League champions. Of course they had to ride their luck and were helped by Max Dowman’s debatable sending off but football is rarely about logic, it is one of emotion. This is once in a lifetime for the Cod Army, for anyone at their level, and they enjoyed it.

A year ago Lawlor was not even a football manager, he never played professionally and started his coaching career with the Manchester United Foundation. Lynch had spent much of his early career in non-league, only dreaming of playing a team who narrowly lost the Champions League final in the spring.

Everyone was expecting a routine victory, even with Mikel Arteta giving youngsters the chance to impress. If Arteta wanted to test his youngsters then Marli Salmon’s naivety was shown up by Loupalo-Bi, on loan from Fulham.

He has been learning his trade in the fourth tier this season and put into practice the skill of using his body against a defender, spinning and holding off the 17-year-old before slotting under Illan Meslier to bring lift-off for the second time of the night.

By that point the game had already had a six-minute delay due to a drone being flown above the pitch. The referee Michael Salisbury had to take the players to the sidelines while the police searched for the culprit outside the ground. It was an unordinary start to what became an extraordinary night on the Fylde Coast. It had started with a plethora of pyrotechnics that created a red haze across the pitch and, frankly, it never dissipated, literally or metaphorically.

The first half was one of toil for Arsenal, unable to create anything meaningful, constantly being thwarted by the disciplined defence, well organised by Lawlor and his staff. The Gunners were pedestrian against a team happy to watch them go through the motions. Kai Havertz missed the best chance to equalise before the break but his header was wayward, summing up a difficult match for him.

After the break it was different as Martin Ødegaard came on to become the quarterback for Arsenal, creating the rhythm they had sorely lacked. He brought cohesion and intensity, getting them back into the game.

It was Gyökeres who bundled home the equaliser and few would have doubted Arsenal going on to win the match but Fleetwood held firm.

The home side had been direct from the start, accepting their limitations and knowing the conditions would help them. Swirling wind helped hold the ball up in the sky and confused defenders not used to the gales by the sea.

Fleetwood’s robust play irritated Arsenal and Dowman was wound up, getting himself sent off for reacting to enforcer-in-chief Harrison Neal. He was the second Gunners teenager to learn a valuable lesson of life outside the top flight after Salmon was exposed for the goal.

It may have been harsh but it was needlessly petulant from Dowman on an already challenging night for his side. Mikel Arteta had a word with him on the way off. What did Arteta say? “Something that we discussed already before the match.”

Arsenal had two late chances through Ben White and Gyökeres to settle it before the need for spot-kicks, but Lynch produced two fantastic saves as the clock went past 90 minutes to ensure it went to a fittingly dramatic finale, where he could be the hero again on a great night for football and the town of Fleetwood.

items.titleZh: 弗利特伍德点球大战淘汰阿森纳爆出联赛杯冷门
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在联赛杯点球大战中负于英乙球队弗利特伍德，惨遭淘汰。
bodyZh: 距离阿森纳在海布里球场比赛已经过去20多年了，但他们客场对阵英乙球队弗利特伍德（以及同名球场）的经历并没有留下美好回忆，他们在联赛杯中通过点球大战被淘汰出局。获胜的是身穿红白球衣的球队，但这一次它创造了英格兰足球历史上最大的冷门之一。
常规时间内，亚伦·卢帕洛-比与维克托·约克雷斯交替进球，尽管阿森纳占据绝对优势且弗利特伍德顽强抵抗，但枪手未能找到制胜球。主教练马特·劳勒几乎激动得流下眼泪，当康纳·霍伊利把球轰入球门顶角锁定胜局、紧张情绪释放后，他几乎无法控制自己。
在此之前，杰伊·林奇扑出了布鲁诺·吉马良斯的射门，这位前仓库工人扑出了这位巴西国脚的罚球。这是每个人都想看到、但在高度商业化的现代足球世界里极其罕见的剧情。
弗利特伍德本场比赛的目标是赚取40万英镑，但最终得到了无价之宝。所有在场的观众永远不会忘记，他们亲眼目睹了一支第四级别球队淘汰了英超冠军。当然，他们也需要一些运气，并受益于马克斯·多曼有争议的红牌罚下，但足球很少讲究逻辑，它关乎情感。对鳕鱼军团以及任何处于他们这个水平的人来说，这是一生难得的经历，他们享受了这一刻。
一年前，劳勒还不是一名足球教练，他从未踢过职业足球，并从曼联基金会开始了其执教生涯。林奇的大部分早期职业生涯都在非职业联赛中度过，他此前只能梦想与春天时险些输掉欧冠决赛的球队交手。
所有人都期待一场例行公事的胜利，尽管米克尔·阿尔特塔给了年轻人表现的机会。如果说阿尔特塔是想考验年轻人，那么马利·萨尔蒙的天真则被从富勒姆租借而来的卢帕洛-比暴露无遗。
本赛季他一直在第四级别联赛锻炼，并在对阵这名17岁后卫时将利用身体的技巧付诸实践，他转身并扛住防守球员，随后在伊兰·梅利耶脚下推射破门，第二次点燃了全场的气氛。
在此之前，比赛已经因一架无人机在球场上空飞行而延迟了六分钟。主裁判迈克尔·索尔兹伯里不得不将球员带到场边，而警察则在球场外搜寻罪魁祸首。对于这个成为菲尔德海岸非凡之夜的起点来说，这是一个不寻常的开局。比赛伴随着大量烟花开始，在球场上空制造了一层红色薄雾，坦白说，无论在字面意义还是象征意义上，这层薄雾从未消散。
上半场对阿森纳来说是一场苦战，他们无法创造出任何有威胁的进攻，不断被劳勒及其教练组组织严密的纪律防线所化解。面对一支乐于看他们走过场的球队，枪手们的表现显得十分沉闷。凯·哈弗茨错过了中场休息前扳平比分的绝佳机会，他的头球偏出，这也总结了他这场艰难的比赛。
下半场情况有所不同，马丁·厄德高替补登场，成为阿森纳的进攻指挥官，为球队创造了他们急需的节奏。他带来了凝聚力和强度，帮助球队重新回到了比赛中。

时事通讯推广后
约克雷斯门前混战扳平比分，当时很少有人怀疑阿森纳会继续赢得比赛，但弗利特伍德坚守到了最后。
主队从一开始就采取直接的打法，接受自身的局限性，并深知主场条件会对他们有利。盘旋的风势将球滞留在空中，并让不习惯海风狂风的后卫们感到困惑。
弗利特伍德强硬的踢法激怒了阿森纳，多曼情绪失控，因对阵核心哈里森·尼尔做出反应而被红牌罚下。在萨尔蒙因失球暴露出问题后，他是第二个从顶级联赛之外的生活中吸取宝贵教训的枪手青少年。
在球队已经颇具挑战性的夜晚，多曼的举动或许有些严厉，但也确实显得不必要地急躁。米克尔·阿尔特塔在多曼离场时和他交谈了几句。阿尔特塔说了什么？“我们赛前就已经讨论过的事情。”
阿森纳随后通过本·怀特和约克雷斯获得了两次扳平比分的晚期机会，但在比赛时间超过90分钟后，林奇作出了两次精彩的扑救，确保比赛进入了戏剧性的终局，他也得以再次成为足球和弗利特伍德镇伟大之夜的英雄。

items.summaryEn: All the details from our Carabao Cup fourth round clash v Fleetwood Town at Highbury Stadium
bodyEn: We exited the Carabao Cup fourth round after losing 5-3 on penalties to Fleetwood Town at Highbury Stadium.
Aaron Luopalo-Bi gave the League Two side a shock lead after 21 minutes before Viktor Gyokeres levelled early in the second half.
We had plenty of chances to win in normal time, as referee Michael Salisbury sent off Max Dowman late on before the game went to spot kicks.

Both sides remained perfect until Bruno Guimaraes missed his spot kick, which gave Conor Haughey the chance to win the match and send the League Two side through to the quarter-finals for the first time in their history.
FISHERMEN MAKE EARLY CATCH

Play stopped after just 93 seconds due to drone interference, causing an almost eight-minute disruption. When the match restarted, we had the opening chance as Piero Hincapie headed over Dowman's free-kick.
The free-kick taker almost turned goalscorer as Marli Salmon's through ball deflected through to the winger, who found himself one-on-one with Jay Lynch but dragged his shot wide.

But down the other end, the deadlock was broken by our hosts. Harrison Neal's ball through the midfield found Aaron Loupalo-Bi, who outmuscled Salmon before finishing low between Illan Meslier's legs to give the League Two side the lead.
It took a while for us to respond to the shock of falling behind. Viktor Gyokeres' shot from range after 29 minutes was the first on target for the visitors.
Chances were proving hard to come by, but it was Dowman who was at the heart of our creativity. A whipped cross found the head of Kai Havertz, who could only plant his effort into The Memorial Stand.
With seven minutes of stoppage time to play, we looked to finish the half strongly. Jurrien Timber headed over the bar from another Dowman cross the best we produced before the break.
FORCING THE ISSUE
The second half brought two changes from Mikel Arteta as he introduced skipper Martin Odegaard and right-back Ben White for Timber and Salmon.
The changes brought more energy and we found a way back into the game through Gyokeres.
A dangerous ball from debutant Ceadach O'Neill caused confusion in the box, and the Swedish forward was able to flick his shot past Lynch and into the net.

Chances were starting to flow for the Gunners, and we almost took the lead. A wonderful touch from Dowman allowed the teenager to fire a cross into the box, where it fell kindly for Havertz, whose effort was pawed over the bar by Lynch.

From the resulting corner, a well-constructed move saw us find Myles Lewis-Skelly in space, but the midfielder curled just wide. Odegaard was pulling the strings and his dink through ball found Havertz, only for the German to hit the side netting.
As we edged into the last 25 minutes of the match, another was passed up. A neat through ball from Odegaard fed Havertz, who squared to Lewis-Skelly, but he fired wide from close range.
LATE DRAMA
The game drifted into the final 10 minutes with both teams looking for the winner before the match was forced to penalties.

Meslier denied substitute Ronan Coughlan before a flashpoint saw Dowman sent off. A reckless tackle from Neal saw Dowman respond and in the following scuffle, referee Michael Salisbury produced a red card for the youngster.
As the board went up for five minutes of stoppage time, Eberechi Eze rolled the ball across the box and found Ben White at the back post, but his effort was kept out by Lynch on the line.
That proved to be our final chance as we couldn't find a way through the League Two side, meaning the game would be settled by spot kicks.
PENALTIES
With spot kicks being taken in front of the Fleetwood faithful, both sides buried their first three penalties each.
Odegaard, Havertz and Gyokeres netting for the Gunners, with Neal, Coughlan, and Will Davies finding the net for the hosts.
Andy Cannon then put Fleetwood in front, but Bruno Guimaraes' effort was saved by Lynch low to his left.
That gave Conor Haughey the chance to win it, and he despatched his effort into the top corner to give Fleetwood a historic victory.

WHAT'S NEXT

Following our trip to Fleetwood, we are back in Premier League action, taking on Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday, November 1 at 4.30pm. We then play our third away match in a row, heading to Slavia Prague in the UEFA Champions League.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在联赛杯第四轮点球不敌弗利特伍德镇遭淘汰。
bodyZh: 我们在海布里球场举行的联赛杯第四轮比赛中，通过点球大战以3-5不敌弗利特伍德镇，遗憾出局。
比赛开始21分钟后，阿龙·卢帕洛-比为这支英乙球队取得了令人震惊的领先，随后维克托·哲凯赖什在下半场初段扳平比分。
我们在常规时间内创造了大量进球机会，主裁判迈克尔·萨利斯伯里在比赛尾声罚下了马克斯·多曼，随后比赛进入点球大战。
双方在前几轮点球中均罚全中，直到布鲁诺·吉马良斯罚失点球，这给康纳·霍吉提供了赢得比赛的机会，并历史性地将这支英乙球队送入八强。
渔夫开局抢眼
由于无人机干扰，比赛在仅仅进行93秒后便暂停，中断了近八分钟。比赛重新开始后，我们创造了第一次进攻机会，皮埃罗·因卡皮耶接多曼的任意球头球顶高。
任意球主罚者险些转化为进球功臣，马尔利·萨尔蒙的直塞球折射到这位边锋脚下，他获得与杰伊·林奇单刀的机会，但射门偏出。
但在另一端，主队打破了僵局。哈里森·尼尔的中场直塞找到了阿龙·卢帕洛-比，他扛住萨尔蒙的防守后低射穿过伊兰·梅斯利尔的裆下，帮助英乙球队取得领先。
我们花了一段时间才从落后的震惊中恢复过来。比赛进行到第29分钟时，维克托·哲凯赖什的远射完成了客队全场第一次射正。
进球机会依然难觅，但多曼成为了我们进攻创造力的核心。他的一记传中找到了凯·哈弗茨，但后者的头球攻门顶给了纪念看台的球迷。
随着七分钟的伤停补时展开，我们试图在上半场结束前打出强势表现。尤里恩·廷贝尔接多曼的又一次传中头球攻门顶高，这是我们在中场休息前制造的最佳机会。
加强进攻
下半场米克尔·阿尔特塔做出两处换人调整，用队长马丁·厄德高和右后卫本·怀特换下廷贝尔和萨尔蒙。
换人带来了更多活力，我们通过哲凯赖什找到了扳平比分的方法。
首秀球员凯达奇·奥尼尔送出的一脚威胁传球引发了禁区内的混乱，这位瑞典前锋抢射破门，将球打进林奇把守的球门。
枪手的进攻机会开始涌现，我们险些取得领先。多曼精彩的触球让这位少年前锋将传中送入禁区，皮球落到哈弗茨脚下，但他的射门被林奇扑出横梁。
随后的角球进攻中，一次精妙的配合让我们找到了处于空当的迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利，但这位中场球员的兜射稍稍偏出。厄德高在盘活进攻，他的一脚挑传找到哈弗茨，但这位德国球员击中了边网。
当比赛进入最后25分钟时，我们又错过了一次机会。厄德高送出精妙直塞给哈弗茨，哈弗茨横传给刘易斯-斯凯利，但他在近距离的射门偏出。
尾声戏剧性一幕
比赛进入最后10分钟，双方都在寻找制胜球，随后比赛被迫进入点球大战。
梅斯利尔扑出了替补出场的罗南·科夫林的射门，随后发生冲突导致多曼被罚下。尼尔的一次危险铲球引发多曼的回应，在随后的推搡中，主裁判迈克尔·萨利斯伯里向这名年轻球员出示了红牌。
当显示五分钟伤停补时的牌子举起时，埃贝雷奇·埃泽将球横扫到禁区后点，找到本·怀特的射门被林奇在门线上化解。
事实证明这是我们最后的机会，我们无法攻破这支英乙球队的防线，这意味着比赛将通过点球大战分出胜负。
点球大战
在弗利特伍德球迷面前进行的点球大战中，双方前三轮点球全部罚进。
厄德高、哈弗茨和哲凯赖什为枪手罚进，尼尔、科夫林和威廉·戴维斯为为主队建功。
随后安迪·坎农罚进帮助弗利特伍德领先，但布鲁诺·吉马良斯的低射被林奇扑向左下角的扑救化解。
这给了康纳·霍吉制胜的机会，他将球罚入球门顶角，为弗利特伍德带来了一场历史性的胜利。

在结束了弗利特伍德之行后，我们将重返英超赛场，于11月1日星期日下午4点30分客场对阵利物浦。随后我们将迎来连续第三个客场比赛，前往欧冠联赛挑战布拉格斯拉维亚。

items.titleEn: Horseman proud of "deserved" EFL Trophy win
items.summaryEn: Our head coach was delighted to see us come from behind to beat AFC Wimbledon and reach the EFL Trophy knockout stages
bodyEn: David Horseman was full of praise for our under-21s as we came from behind to beat AFC Wimbledon 2-1 in the EFL Trophy, securing a spot in the knockout stages of the competition.
After a goalless first half, Callum Maycock gave the hosts the lead right at the start of the second half, but we hit back 25 minutes later through Evan Mooney.

Both sides pushed for a winner in the closing stages, but it was our young Gunners who prevailed thanks to another late, decisive moment from Emerson Nwaneri, who netted an 87th-minute winner to send us through.

"I'm really proud of the players," Horseman said on the performance, "we were quite young, we had three 16-year olds playing, fully deserved, and then the under-21s had a bit of a tough one on Saturday.
"So to come to a place like this against a very good team, and then obviously the physical mismatches that these games produce, I'm really proud to get the win.

"I think it was fully deserved, I thought we played really well, created a lot of chances, but in some ways it feels better because we had to come from behind. So it's a massive achievement for the players, and I'm really proud of them tonight."

The result sees us progress to the last 32 of the competition regardless of the result in the final game between Barnet and Leyton Orient, although we could jump up to top spot if the O's inflict a heavy defeat on the group-leading Bees.
Either way, Horseman said our young Gunners will look forward to their first knockout tie, with the competition a difficult one for under-21s sides historically.
"Look, you want to win every game, but traditionally in this competition, not just Arsenal, [it's difficult]. I think West Ham were the only ones last year to qualify, they were quite an old team.
"So for us to do it, particularly after the start against Barnet, where obviously we barely had a back four in place, and to lose 5-1, is brilliant.

"We've gone away to two League 1 teams and won 2-1, and to play in the stadiums against proper league players in a game that you have to win, I think we've just got to keep giving them as many [of these games as possible]."
With the group stages successfully navigated, we'll be back in EFL Trophy action in December.
While a date for the draw is yet to be confirmed, Horseman is hoping to bring his squad together to find out who we'll face for a place in the last 16.
"It's something to really, really look forward to. It's uncharted territory for Arsenal and most under-21s teams.
"I'm not sure when the draw is, but when [the details] come out, we'll have a bit of an event and sit together and really enjoy it as a group."

items.titleZh: 霍斯曼为“实至名归”的英锦赛胜利感到骄傲
items.summaryZh: 主教练对球队逆转战胜AFC温布尔登并晋级英锦赛淘汰赛阶段感到高兴。
bodyZh: 大卫-霍斯曼对我们的U21梯队赞不绝口，我们在英锦赛中以2比1逆转战胜AFC温布尔登，锁定了赛事淘汰赛阶段的席位。
在上半场互交白卷后，卡勒姆-梅科克在下半场刚开始时为主队取得领先，但25分钟后埃文-穆尼为我们扳平了比分。
双方在尾声阶段都全力争胜，但凭借埃默森-恩瓦内里在第87分钟攻入的制胜球，我们的年轻枪手笑到了最后，顺利晋级。
“我对球员们感到非常骄傲，”霍斯曼在谈到这场表现时说道，“我们的阵容很年轻，有三名16岁球员登场，这场胜利实至名归，而且U21梯队在上周六刚经历了一场艰难的比赛。”
“因此，能来到这样一个地方对阵一支非常出色的球队，并且克服了这些比赛所带来的身体对抗差距，我为取得这场胜利感到无比骄傲。”
“我认为这是实至名归的，我们踢得非常好，创造了很多机会，而且从某种角度来看，经历落后后的逆转让感觉更好了。这对球员们来说是一个巨大的成就，今晚我为他们感到非常自豪。”
这个结果意味着无论巴尼特和莱顿东方最后一场比赛的结果如何，我们都将晋级赛事三十二强，不过如果莱顿东方大胜小组领头羊巴尼特，我们甚至有可能升至小组头名。
无论如何，霍斯曼表示我们的年轻枪手将期待他们的首场淘汰赛，从历史来看，这项赛事对U21球队来说一直非常艰难。
“听着，你总是想赢得每一场比赛，但传统上在这项赛事中，不仅是阿森纳，[想要晋级]都很困难。我认为西汉姆联去年是唯一一支晋级的球队，他们当时派出了年龄偏大的阵容。”
“所以我们能做到这一点，尤其是在对阵巴尼特的开局并不顺利——当时我们甚至凑不齐一条后防线并以1比5落败——之后取得现在的成绩，这太棒了。”
“我们客场击败了两支英甲球队并都以2比1取胜，能在球场上面对真正的职业联赛球员并在必须取胜的比赛中做到这一点，我认为我们必须继续为他们提供尽可能多[这样的比赛]。”
随着小组赛的顺利通过，我们将在12月重返英锦赛的赛场。
虽然抽签日期尚未最终确定，但霍斯曼希望将球队聚在一起，看看我们在争夺十六强席位的比赛中将会面对哪个对手。
“这真的非常令人期待。对于阿森纳和大多数U21球队来说，这是未知的领域。”
“我不确定抽签是什么时候，但当[具体细节]出来时，我们会搞一个小活动，大家坐在一起，作为团队好好享受这一刻。”

items.summaryEn: We reached the knockout stages of the EFL Trophy with a comeback win in south London
bodyEn: We reached the knockout stages of the EFL Trophy for the first time in the group stage format as we came from behind to beat League One AFC Wimbledon 2-1 at the Cherry Red Records Stadium on Tuesday night.
A goalless first half wasn't without action as fantastic goal-saving blocks from Freddie Simmonds for Wimbledon and Elijah Upson for us were required to keep the scores blank in the opening 45.

Wimbledon took the lead right at the start of the second half through Callum Maycock, but we struck back with 20 minutes to play through substitute Evan Mooney, before Emerson Nwaneri continued his recent heroics with an 87th-minute winner.
FIRST HALF

Wimbledon probed in the early stages of the contest, keeping the game in our half, and came close to an early lead when Aron Sasu broke free on the right and forced a strong save from Khari Ranson from a tight angle.

We responded to the wake-up call with a chance of our own at the other end with Theo Julienne threading an excellent pass through to Mylo Bernard. Bernard took the ball in stride but lifted his effort over the crossbar.

Our young Gunners continued to keep the pressure on in the opening 20 minutes, with both James Scanlon and Igor Tyjon having efforts blocked in the penalty area as we took control of proceedings in south London.

The best chance of the half fell to James Scanlon shortly after, with the midfielder seemingly one-on-one with Joe McDonnell after a defensive miscue from Wimbledon, but Simmonds made a charging recovery run to save the Dons.
It was soon our turn to appreciate a goal-saving challenge as Upson flung himself in front of a shot from Ed Leach that had been heading for the corner of the net, keeping our clean sheet in tact.

We were on top towards the end of an entertaining first half and almost took the lead with a flowing move, only for Julienne to put a close-range effort straight at McDonnell with the goal at his mercy.
SECOND HALF

The Dons made a quick start to the second half, threatening in the opening minute. Steven Sessegnon broke forward and cut in on his right foot, before bending a fiercely struck effort just over the crossbar.
But a minute later the hosts were more clinical, taking the lead through a well-placed strike from Maycock, who picked out the bottom corner from just inside the penalty area.

We stepped up our tempo and enjoyed a good spell of possession after going behind, and forced the first save of real quality from McDonnell when Emerson Nwaneri drove a powerful effort towards goal from the edge of the 18-yard box.

Wimbledon came back into the game midway through the half and should've doubled their lead when Simmonds picked out Harry Hedges in space in the penalty area, but the Dons' winger struck the crossbar from close range.
With the hosts high up the pitch chasing a second goal, we caught them out on the counter-attack and found our equaliser through Mooney, who latched onto Nwaneri's ball across goal from close range.

The final 20 minutes was played at a high intensity with both sides vying for a winner, but it was our young Gunners who came out on top as Nwaneri's deflected effort found the bottom corner in the 87th-minute to send us through to the last 32.
WHAT IT MEANS
Victory in south London means we sit second in Southern Group F, guaranteeing our place in the last 32 in the week commencing Monday, December 7.
If Barnet, who are already through were to lose heavily at home to Leyton Orient in the final match in the group, we would win the group on goal difference.
WHAT'S NEXT
With the EFL Trophy knockout stages not getting underway until December, the next game for many of our young Gunners will be in Czechia against Slavia Prague in the UEFA Youth League.
Our under-21s are back in action on Sunday, November 8 with a Premier League 2 clash against Aston Villa at Mangata Developments Stadium (2pm UK).

Subs: Bishop, Seddon, Johnson, Stockley

items.summaryZh: 我们在客场逆转取胜，晋级英格兰足球联赛锦标赛淘汰赛阶段。
bodyZh: 周二晚上，我们在切里雷德球场以2-1逆转战胜英甲球队AFC温布尔登，在小组赛赛制下首次晋级英格兰足球联赛锦标赛的淘汰赛阶段。
上半场双方互交白卷，但并不缺乏精彩场面，温布尔登的弗雷迪·西蒙兹和我们的埃利贾·厄普森分别做出精彩的门线救险，力保前45分钟球门不失。
温布尔登在下半场刚开始时由卡勒姆·梅科克取得领先，但我们在比赛还剩20分钟时由替补登场的埃文·穆尼扳平比分，随后埃默森·恩瓦内里在第87分钟打入制胜球，延续了他近期的神勇表现。
上半场
温布尔登在比赛初段频频试探，将战局控制在我们半场，并险些早早取得领先，当时阿龙·萨苏在右路摆脱防守，逼迫哈里·兰森在小角度做出一次神勇扑救。
我们随后做出回应，在对方禁区制造威胁，西奥·朱利安送出一记精妙直塞找到迈洛·伯纳德。伯纳德顺势接球，但射门稍稍高出横梁。
在比赛的前20分钟里，我们的青年枪手持续施压，詹姆斯·斯坎伦和伊戈尔·泰永的射门均在禁区内被封堵，我们逐渐掌控了在南伦敦的局势。
上半场最好的机会不久后落在了詹姆斯·斯坎伦脚下，温布尔登防线失误后，这位中场球员似乎获得了与乔·麦克唐纳单刀的机会，但西蒙兹高速回追完成了关键解围。
很快轮到我们展现精彩的门线救险，厄普森飞身挡出了埃德·利奇直奔球门死角的射门，力保我们的城门不失。
在精彩的上半场尾声阶段我们占据上风，并险些通过一次流畅的配合取得领先，但朱利安在门前绝佳机会下的近距离射门被麦克唐纳直接没收。
下半场
温布尔登在下半场开局阶段迅速进入状态，并在第一分钟制造威胁。史蒂文·塞塞尼翁带球向前内切并起右脚兜射，皮球稍稍高出横梁。
但仅仅一分钟后，主队展现了更高的效率，梅科克在禁区边缘迎球推射破门，打入死角，帮助主队取得领先。
丢球后我们提升了比赛节奏，并掌控了一段时间的球权，迫使麦克唐纳做出了一次高质量扑救，当时埃默森·恩瓦内里在18码禁区边缘轰出一脚极具威胁的重炮轰门。
温布尔登在下半场中段重新掌握主动，本有机会扩大领先优势，当时西蒙兹在禁区内找到无人防守的哈里·赫奇斯，但这位温布尔登边锋近距离射门击中横梁。
随着主队全线压上寻找第二球，我们抓住反击机会扳平比分，穆尼接应恩瓦内里横传门前包抄破门。
最后的20分钟比赛节奏极快，双方都在争夺制胜球，但最终还是我们的青年枪手笑到了最后，恩瓦内里在第87分钟的射门发生折射钻入球门死角，将我们送入32强。
这意味着什么
客场取胜意味着我们在南方F组排名第二，确保了我们晋级12月7日那一周进行的最后32强。
如果已经晋级的巴尼特在小组最后一场比赛中主场惨败给莱顿东方，我们将凭借净胜球优势获得小组头名。
接下来
由于英格兰足球联赛锦标赛淘汰赛直到12月才开始，我们的许多青年枪手下一场比赛将前往捷克参加对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的欧洲青年联赛。
我们的U21梯队将于11月8日星期日重返赛场，在曼加塔发展球场进行一场英超2级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛（英国时间下午2点）。

items.summaryEn: Find out who will be starting in our trip to Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup Fourth Round at Highbury Stadium
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has made nine changes for our trip to Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup fourth round, with Illan Meslier and Ceadach O'Neill making their debuts.
Meslier, who joined us in the summer, starts in goal at Highbury Stadium, with Northern Ireland international O'Neill, 18, making his first senior appearance.
Jurrien Timber starts at right-back, with teenager Marli Salmon, Cristhian Mosquera and Piero Hincapie completing the backline.
Martin Zubimendi, who made a substitute appearance against Everton, starts in midfield alongside Myles Lewis-Skelly.
Ceadach is on the opposite wing to fellow teenager Max Dowman, who was player of the round last month after a sparkling display against Ipswich Town.
Kai Havertz and Viktor Gyokeres complete the line-up as we bid to reach the last eight for the third year in a row.

Arsenal: Meslier, Timber, Salmon, Mosquera, Hincapie, Zubimendi, Lewis-Skelly, Dowman, O’Neill, Havertz, Gyokeres
Substitutes: Arrizabalaga, White, Odegaard, Eze, Konsa, Guimaraes, Harriman-Annous, Washington, Hashi
